description: Mediterranean Soul's 2013 Life Red Blend is a warm-climate Golan Heights red with ripe dark fruit, sweet spice, and an easy, rounded palate. Its mature profile favors generosity and softness over firm structure.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 2013 Mediterranean Soul Life Red Blend from the Golan Heights.
sommelierNotes: Serve at 16-18°C with grilled meats, braised lamb, or roasted eggplant; a short decant will help the fruit and spice settle together.
